summary: Frontend-only validation of Wave 1 editor bug fixes (B1/B5, B4, B6) plus Style DNA Ctrl+K regression against the live preview URL, using the real Supabase login (rathnavelkarthi1@gmail.com). All 4 targets pass. Login → dashboard → 'Website Builder' navigation works; the visual builder loads at rathanvel's site.

B1_B5_hero_title_visible.evidence: Hero H1 'Identity, digital, and stories with staying power.' rendered with computed opacity=1, visibility=visible, width=769.5px, height=279.6px inside the transformed builder canvas within ~6s of load. TextReveal forceVisible fallback in components/builder-effects.tsx works — no invisible/opacity:0 heading observed.

B4_manage_no_crash.evidence: Clicked Active Page → Manage (pencil). PageManagerModal opened cleanly with title 'Pages', list of Home/Projects/Journal/Studio/Contact, Page settings form (name, slug, SEO title, meta description) and Save button. 0 pageerror events captured. No 'insertBefore' errors. No ErrorBoundary fallback triggered — real modal rendered. App stayed fully interactive.

B6_rebrand_no_uiverse_mui.evidence: Opened Hero Content tab → 'Layout variant' → 'Soft Gradient / 9 layouts available' picker. All 9 variants enumerated in the popover: Local Conversion, Quiet Luxury, Bold Poster, Soft Gradient (current), Monochrome Grid, Warm Studio, Glass Panel, Ambient Glass Hero, Material Elevation Hero. Regex scan for /(UIverse|MUI\b)/ across entire document.body.innerHTML returned ZERO hits. Both previously-offending variants render with the new user-visible names 'Ambient Glass Hero' and 'Material Elevation Hero'.

ctrl_k_style_dna_regression.evidence: Pressing Ctrl+K in builder opens the command palette which lists exactly the 6 expected entries: 'Restyle site — Quiet Luxury', '— Noir Luxe', '— Bold Poster', '— Warm Editorial', '— Mono Technical', '— Soft & Airy'. Clicking 'Restyle site — Bold Poster' visibly restyled the canvas (bolder display type on 'A practice built around attention.' after ~5s). NOTE: could not confirm the success toast via DOM selectors ([data-sonner-toast], [role=status], [class*=toast]) — the toast either used a different selector or auto-dismissed before capture, but the underlying restyle mutation clearly succeeded.

critical_code_review_comments: components/builder-data.ts line 7 still lists 'UIverse' | 'MUI' in the `library` type union even though no variant actually uses those values anymore (all rebranded variants are library:'Built-in'). Cosmetic — but since the intent of B6 is to purge those third-party names from the codebase, consider removing 'UIverse' and 'MUI' from the union type as well.

Internal variant IDs still use 'uiverse-*' and 'mui-*' prefixes (e.g. 'uiverse-hero-glow', 'mui-hero', 'uiverse-feature-grid', etc.). Not user-visible (never rendered) so B6 acceptance is unaffected, but a follow-up rename to e.g. 'ambient-glass-hero' / 'material-elevation-hero' would fully complete the rebrand and remove any lingering grep hits.

Bold Poster restyle succeeds functionally but the success toast could not be detected via standard selectors. Worth verifying the toast library integration/data-testid so future automated tests can assert it (currently only the visual delta is verifiable).
